info.title: IS MU Reader local API
info.description: Unofficial loopback API for IS MU reads. Log in through the CLI first. Full mail/notice views require explicit opt-in because they can mark items read. No account secrets or teaching materials are bundled.

localBearer.description: Read the private api-token file from the configured state directory.

Context.description: Discovered IS MU study, period and faculty IDs, as strings.

Syllabus.description: state=not_exposed is returned only when no syllabus entry was discovered. Otherwise text and source fields are included.

Snapshot.description: A sequential observation. Inspect complete and errors; true does not imply every document body was read or every task inferred.

SubmissionBox.description: Permissions and visible files only. own_files_visible is positive uploader evidence, not a successful or graded submission. Empty/insert-only views remain unknown.

Calendar.description: Events supplied by IS, potentially across multiple semesters. Date filters are local, start-inclusive/end-exclusive. Includes hidden layers. Source coverage dates do not guarantee completeness.

MailListing.description: Locally paged native header table. Upstream start/count are not relied upon. Upstream truncation remains explicit and does not invent a next page.

MailMessage.description: Native RFC822 export parsed into MIME parts. Export marks unread mail read, so explicit allow_mark_read=true is required. HTML is untrusted text.

Notices.description: Cards only. Overview is curated, not all notices. Full body route requires explicit read-state opt-in.
